summary: Iteration 5 validated the new signup + face-enrollment + Enable-Camera fallback features end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_signup_auth.py covering POST /api/auth/signup (valid 200, duplicate 409 against both demo and DB users, invalid email/short pw/invalid role all 400), bcrypt $2b$ hash format verified in db.users, login regression for both demo accounts (driver/broker) + new DB-backed user (bcrypt verify path), /auth/me works for both demo and DB tokens and never leaks password_hash, /models/tiny_face_detector_model-weights_manifest.json returns 200. Frontend: holo-orb-enable-btn is visible with text 'Enable Camera' on /login (camera-denied fallback works — no more silent CAM OFFLINE). /signup step 1 renders all 9 expected testids (form, role tabs/driver/broker, name/email/password/callsign/license, next-btn). Empty submit correctly blocks advance. Filling valid fields advances to step 2 which exposes signup-enroll, signup-face, signup-hint, signup-back-btn, signup-finish-btn, plus the FaceCapture's signup-face-enable-btn; signup-finish-btn is disabled until 3 face samples captured. Back button returns to step 1. signup-link from /login navigates to /signup. Driver demo login (driver@jadeos.com/jade123) and broker login (broker@jadeos.com/jade123) both still land on /driver and /broker respectively. Rapid nav across driver tabs (gps, logs, jade, dashboard) — 0 console errors. Test users deleted from db.users at session end (0 remaining).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:106-114 — hash_password uses bcrypt.gensalt() defaults (12 rounds) and verify_password safely catches ValueError/TypeError on malformed hashes. Clean.

server.py:251-285 — /auth/signup correctly: lowercases email, blocks empty/no-@ (400), enforces password>=6 (400), validates role enum (400), blocks demo collision AND db duplicate (409). Race condition is also covered by the unique index on users.email created in startup hook (line 1131). Good defense-in-depth.

server.py:117-137 — _lookup_user normalizes db user vs demo user shape correctly. password_hash is intentionally surfaced internally for verification but the current_user wrapper pops both 'password' and 'password_hash' before returning to clients. Verified via test_me_db_token.

Login.jsx triggerFaceLogin — for self-signed-up users it prompts via window.prompt() for password each session — works but note this is a UX trade-off (acceptable per problem statement; flagged as 'a future iteration can swap this for a device-bound refresh token').
Signup.jsx finish() — averages descriptors then calls signupAndLogin + saveEnrollment. If signupAndLogin throws (e.g., 409), enrollment is NOT saved — correct behaviour, no orphan localStorage entry.

HoloOrb.jsx — exposes data-testid='holo-orb-enable-btn' for both initial (phase=idle) and recovery (phase=denied/error) paths. This properly fixes the previously silent 'CAM OFFLINE' issue noted in the request.
